Senior Android Developer
Oct. 20, 2026
We are looking for Senior Android Developers to work on financial projects developed together with one of the largest banks in Romania.
 Your Profile
Academic qualification in a technical field (IT or similar)
Senior-level, with 7+ years of relevant experience
Strong analytical and synthetical skills
Awareness of software vulnerabilities and a security-oriented mindset
Willingness to learn and team-oriented attitude
Ability to prioritize tasks and work with attention to detail
Strong problem-solving skills coupled with excellent communication skills
Customer centric, passionate about delivering great digital products and services
Experience with financial-banking projects is a plus
Experience with both Kotlin and Java
Solid understanding of Kotlin’s modern features and best practices
Proficiency with Kotlin Coroutines and/or RxJava for handling asynchronous tasks
Extensive knowledge of the Android-SDK, including core components such as Activities, Services, Content Providers, and Broadcast receivers
Good knowledge of security in Android applications
Solid understanding of unit and UI testing (JUnit, Espresso, Mockito)
Experience with static analysis tools – SonarQube, Android Lint, Detekt, or similar
Proficiency with Android Jetpack components, such as Navigation, viewModel, LiveData, Room and Workmanager
Good understanding of REST API’s, JSON and networking libraries like Retrofit or OKHttp
 Your Role
Develop clean, efficient, and maintainable code with a strong focus on performance, scalability and reusability
Design and develop Android applications based on project specifications and user requirements
Conduct unit testing and maintain Java applications to ensure high quality, reliability, and an optimal user experience
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to analyze requirements and deliver robust, high-quality features
Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues to enhance application performance and functionality
